sn45.6:1.2: Then a certain bhikkhu approached the Blessed One…. Sitting to one side, that bhikkhu said to the Blessed One:
sn45.6:1.3: “Venerable sir, it is said, ‘the holy life, the holy life.’
sn45.6:1.4: What, venerable sir, is the holy life? What is the final goal of the holy life?”
sn45.6:2.1: “This Noble Eightfold Path, bhikkhu, is the holy life; that is,
sn45.6:2.3: The destruction of lust, the destruction of hatred, the destruction of delusion:
sn45.6:2.4: this is the final goal of the holy life.”
